question: Hemavati is the tributary of _____________ river.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Godavari**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Hemavati is a tributary of the Kaveri River
 
• It originates from the Western Ghats in the Chikmagalur district of Karnataka and joins the Kaveri River near the town of Krishna Raja Sagara.
